content: We used sentencepiece BIBREF4 to parse into sub-word units and reduce the possible out-of-vocabulary terms in the data set. We selected a vocab size of 30,000 and used the byte-pair encoding (BPE) model. To our knowledge this is the first time that the BPE toenization has been used with ULMFiT in a competition model.
